item.title: Ask HN: Non-engineers, how often do you code products? And how?
item.summary: I've been talking to many non-technical (people who haven't worked as engineers before) people and I'm surprised by the amount of code and automation they are writing (especially across platforms). Would love to hear if others are doing similar? And how? Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49427236 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
